About Me

I simply write the things I sometimes cannot say.

Hi, I’m Sarang.

I don’t always know how to say what I feel, so I write it instead.

This space is about life, people, memories, emotions, and the little things that stay with us.

If something here feels familiar to you, then maybe you’ll understand why I write.

Welcome to Words From Within.

— Sarang
